titulo_original: Darlene Love: I Know Where I've Been

sinopsis.es: Estrellas como Bruce Springsteen, Cher y Dionne Warwick cantan las alabanzas de un icono musical poco reconocido, en este retrato animoso y cálido del director canadiense Barry Avrich (Oscar Peterson: Black + White).
sinopsis.en: Stars like Bruce Springsteen, Cher, and Dionne Warwick sing the praises of an underappreciated musical icon in this high-spirited and warm-hearted portrait from Canadian director Barry Avrich (Oscar Peterson: Black + White, TIFF ’21).
